title: 年末の予定アイコン
lead: 大掃除・年賀状・帰省・忘年会など、年末にすることを表すアイコン12点です。社内連絡、回覧、チェックリストに使えます。
subject_en: year-end task pictogram icons, each a separate object, bold and clear, no text. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a bucket with a sponge and a cleaning cloth
a postcard with a stamp mark, blank
a suitcase and a train ticket
a desk with a closed laptop and a calendar page
a shopping basket with vegetables and a fish
a paper form with a calculator
a calendar with the last days circled
a temple bell with a wooden striker
a bowl of soba noodles with chopsticks
a wrapped gift box with a delivery truck
